_comment: SteampunkClock (spclock) configuration. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees, robot frame = uArm frame.

camera._auth_comment: one line user:password, mode 600, next to this file on the worker; not in the repo

calibration._comment: 2026-11-16: robot->grid from 5 tile drops (sorter/calib_grid.py), image->grid from the drawn 100 mm grid in the 1600x1200 image (sorter/grid_cal.json)

motion._place_comment: x, y, dx, dy: mm added to place targets near (x, y); from spclock calplace

layout._comment: Keypad of stacks on the drawn grid: cell k at grid (row_x0 + row_pitch*(k/3), col_y0 + col_pitch*(k%3)); digit tops along grid -x
layout._photo_comment: photo_spot is in the ROBOT frame (free table where the heap was); temp_cell is a keypad cell index
layout._display_comment: H1 H2 M1 M2 in grid mm, 40 mm pitch with a 10 mm colon gap, centred on the user's coin at grid (27.5, 98.5) on the centre line; Hh left, Mm right (2026-11-15)
